display_long_description:
This app provides an immersive virtual reality environment with guided sessions designed to support attention, memory and logical thinking.

Inside a calm and organized virtual space, users engage with interactive activities that encourage focus, organization, pattern recognition and problem solving. Each session is led by a virtual instructor who explains tasks, guides the experience and helps users move smoothly between activities.

The experience is designed to be simple, comfortable and intuitive. All activities take place within arm’s reach, with no physical movement required, ensuring a safe and accessible experience.

Additional features can be unlocked by creating an account at irispace.app, allowing you to integrate sessions, access new functionalities, and enhance your experience over time.

Key features:
• Guided sessions
• Interactive focus, memory and logic activities
• Comfortable seated experience
• Fully offline functionality
• Clear and simple navigation
• Suitable for individual or supervised use

Enter the space, choose a session and start right away.
